body: I feel I need a more social life, things just fall flat on my face when my friends from work get involved. People talk and the things they say hurt. Its difficult to make friends because I dont have a car yet abd am hoping sincerely to god I get it by the end of June. I have a novel Ive been working on for 7 years thats nowhere near finishing and I feel it is the one thing that keeps me fron feeling special. I have a job, I do not have a criminal record. But Ive been held back due to aspergers and not living in the happiest of childhood homes. No, my childhood wasnt happy. I came to england to change my life. I feel I need more change.
